lead.name: Navya
lead.trait: Turns every complaint into the next feature.

title: Mahj League
oneLiner: Web page that keeps weekly standings for American mahjong clubs and leagues, points only, no app install
customer: Organisers of American mahjong clubs, open play nights and leagues in the US
revenueModel: Paid season unlock per club; free single-game score sheet as the search magnet

evidence.claim: Public radio reported in Jan 2026 that a century old tile game, mahjong, is suddenly drawing younger players and new clubs across the US.
People buy printable American mahjong score cards and hand trackers on Etsy even though free scoring calculators exist.
A dedicated club and league app for American mahjong now exists on the App Store, showing organisers want league tooling.

nextAction: Navya validates: check Mahjic, MahWins and other league tools for price and free tier, find organisers asking for league standings, and confirm the gap. 3 sourced signals already on file, so the lead can move it to validated if the gap holds; then Research writes the case. Screen (ap-company-2): payers despite free tools = Etsy score cards and league apps; free single-game calculators exist (https://mahjongg.ai.studio/tools/scoring-calculator/), the named gap is multi-week, multi-table club standings on a phone web page with no install. Searches to rank for: mahjong league scoring, mahjong score sheet, how to run a mahjong league; small sites such as https://mahjong4friends.com/guides/american-mahjong-scoring already rank. Against: Mahjic and MahWins apps may already close the gap; check their prices and free tiers. Legal: points only, never money or stakes, never reproduce the NMJL card.
